Name: Emyn's Diverse Mermaid Show
Author: yishaqeni
Description:
Hello! This is a tiny mod that amends the Mermaid Show in the Night Market. I was kinda disappointed that the mermaid show only had variations on one form of mermaid, so I added a few more for a full range of ethnically diverse merfolk based on different fish. I've also altered their clothes to be more diverse.

I've altered the default sprites to represent 4 kinds of mermaid:

[list]
[*]Yellow Tang
[*]Steller Sea Lion

[*]Zebra Lionfish
[*]Clownfish

[/list][b]
Requirements:

- [/b]Stardew Valley 1.4+
- Content Patcher 1.11.0+
- SMAPI 3.0.1+

[b]Install

[/b]Just drag and drop into your mod folder.

Downloads.Description: Version 1.0, to work with Content Patcher 1.11.0 and SMAPI 3.0.1
